title: Xreal Aura is a new wired headset powered by Android XR | TechCrunch
summary: At the Android Dev Summit on Wednesday, Google’s smart glasses partner Xreal launched its new Xreal Aura wired smart glasses, powered by the Android XR and Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Reality Elite platforms.
